paraphrase: Proposes a verification gate before any external action is marked finished: what changed, where is the receipt, does the receipt match the instruction. Receipt must be operation-type specific: PR URL for a PR task, read-after-write query for a database task, sent-message id plus exact template version for a refund email. Identifies the failure mode of narrating success after partial execution (branch created but no PR).

claims.text: Every external action an agent takes should pass through a verification gate before the agent is allowed to call it finished
claims.notes: Gate not confidence score; receipts matched to instruction

claims.text: The receipt is operation-type specific: PR URL for a PR task, read-after-write query for a database task, sent-message id plus exact template version for a refund email
The nasty failure mode is not that agents fail but that they narrate success after partial execution
claims.notes: Example: create the branch but not the PR
